(ja)༄༅/ /'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /gser chos/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpa

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum te/ de la dang po bar chad dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs srung bar 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa dhīḥmathing nag las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'dab ma snyan gong gi thad kar gyes pa'i steng na sher phyin gyi pusti bsnams pa/ rus pa dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ dar gyi cod pan can/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbyings na zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'di la dgug gzhug sogs mi dgos/ de nas sngags brgya rtsa yan chad gang 'grub bzla'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi las la sbyor ba'i tshe/ the tshom dang rtog ngan byung na/ rang 'jam dpal sku mdog nag po/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri me 'bar bas dgra bgegs thams cad la snun par byed pa/ g.yon pusti thugs kar bsnams pa/ lto ba che ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang*/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgoms la rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥkaṃ shaṃ/ rbad phaṭa swā hā/ yang lugs gcig la/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ dur mi sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ traṃ rbad swā hā/ grub na stong dang*/ gzhan nyi shu rtsa gcig re mi chag par bzla/ 'di la gzhan gdams pa bcu gcig te/ dran pa dus kyi gnad/ lta ba phyogs kyi gnad/ 'bud pa rlung gi gnad/

bsgom pa byin rlabs kyi gnad/ bzlas pa sngags kyi gnad/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi gnad/ byug pa bu ga'i gnad/ khang pa sgo'i gnad/ gdab pa rkan sgra'i gnad/ bzlog pa mtheb rgya'i gnad dang bcu gcig go /rim pa bzhin du/ tho rangs skya rengs shar ba'i dus su/ kha shar phyogs su blta/ sgal tshig drang por bsrang*/ rlung sna bug g.yas kyis drangs la/ g.yon la sangs kyis 'bud/ rang 'phags pa khro bor bsgoms pa'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ rtsa sngags sham bur/ rims la/ sarba dz+wā ra/ nad la/ ro ga gdon la/ duṣ+ṭān/ bgegs/ bigh+nān/ gzhan thams cad la/ u pa dra byāḥshān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa gdags/ rdzas ni rang gi rkang pa'i rgyu ma khug gnyis nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dri ma blangs te/ bu ga dgu dang*/ bcu drug 'dzom rnams su byug go /phyi sgo ma phye gong du bya la/ rkan sgra drag po lan gsum bya/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos g.yon pa'i sen mo mnan te/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad kyi rang la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad mnan par bsams la/ 'dis pha rol gyi rbod gtong*/ rims nad dang*/ gdon chen po'i sar 'gro ba/ gza' skar dang*/ phyogs ngan bdud gcod/ khrom dang dge 'dun gyi tshogs dpon byed pa/ sa ma dul ba'i sar dbang skur ba/ hom dang*/ ro sreg gtor zor 'phen pa/ de'i grogs byed pa/ srod dang tho rengs 'gro ba/ ro bag gi grib dang mi gtsang ba/ gto bcos btang ba/ skyas nag dang phrad pa/ sha ma/ chang ma/ shi ba'i bang chen sngon thal/ lag bde/ ro khur ba/ ro shul du nyal ba/ ro sna 'dren pa/ ro gos gyon pa/ sa gnyan brko ba/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ khang pa dbub pa/ zar mi btub pa za ba/ nyor mi btub pa nyo ba/ nyam nga'i rnam rtog ci byung thams cad thub nges pa'i gdams ngag zab mo 'di rang gi bu min pa/ gzhan la gser srang re dang*/ rta sga can re/ 'bum tshar re 'bul zhing nan tan che na sbyin/ gzhan la bka' rgya btab yod/

cho 'phrul che na/ skra spyi bor bcing*/ lha bsgom/ sngags 'dren/ rlung 'bud/ gang la yang rnam rtog dgos re kan/ myong bas grub pa yin 'di'i lung byed pa'i dus gser gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ sngags kyi rjes zlos bdun nam gsum byas la sbyin no// rgya bod gnyis na 'di las zab pa med do// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o// maṅga laṃ// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ rje btsun chen po/ sa skya paṇa chen/ zhang mdo sde pa/ 'jam skya/ mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de'i drung du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lo gnyis kyi bar du gsol ba btab ste hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin dges bzhin tu stsal nas nos pa'o// ༈ /'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// bla ma dang 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal nag po bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde bar 'dug la/ bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal nag po'i sgom bzlas la brtson par bgyi'o// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig las rang nyid 'jam dpal nag po nas/ bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed sgrub thabs ni/

a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥlas 'jam dpal nag po nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ de nas mchod bstod byas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ slar yang mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gis phrin las bcol/ slob ma rjes su bzung bar 'dod pas/ dang por slob ma khrus byas gral la 'khod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i mos pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos gsungs shig kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs lan gsum/ thun mong gi sdom pa 'bogs pa la sogs pa yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ slob ma lhar nges pa'i gsal gdab/ slob ma rnams 'jam dpal nag por gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ bla ma 'jam dpal nag por gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi 'jam dpal gnyis ka'i yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka la mos gus drag por byas pas/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi 'jam dpal gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ las 'jam dpal nag po'i sku'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ de la thim/ de gnyis kyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas āḥdamar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas/ 'jam dpal nag po'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad khyed rang rnams kyis lus ngag yid gsum la khyab par gyur/

badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥsogs brjod/ rol mo bya/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal tha dad ma mchis pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsgom mdzod/ sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ bla mas me tog de'ang slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig thams cad tshul bzhin du bsrung ba'i mos pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum byed/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rjes bsngo ba sogs bya'o// maṅga laṃ/ 'di'i brgyud pa ni bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa ye shes dpal/ mang mkhar ba blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon mchog thugs rje/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po/ slob dpon rin chen chos mchog rtsa ba'i bla ma mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang tshe dbang bkra shis/ mthu stobs dbang phyug rnam rgyal bkra shis/ de la bdag 'a zhwa'i ban+de dbang phyug rab brtan gyis zhus so// de la dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thob pa lags so// maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// ༈ /'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs zab mo bzhugs so// swa sti/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems bskyed de/ de nas pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du skad cig gis rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar zhing*/ phyag g.yon me tog ha lo'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhengs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan can/ spyan gsum bgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa smin ma zhal rgyan dbu skra dmar ser ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ dur mi sod/ gnyan kha la sod/ gnyan mgo la sod/ kaṃ shaṃ traṃ rbad rbad/ rbud rbud thuṃ sod swā hā/ zhes sngags 'di ci nus bgrang*/ lha 'di la gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab mi byed pa kho rang gi lugs yin cing*/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis bsgoms pas chog sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig dang brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'grub bzlas pas/ grib che chung gi rigs thams cad thub cing*/ gnyan rims kyi nad rnams 'joms par nus pa'i sngags rgod byin rlabs can yin/ ces bla mas gsungs shing*/ zas gos gnas mal sogs la 'bags grib yod par dog pa rnams la gsum/ bdun/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas phu btab pa dang bzlas pa'i mchil ma gtor/ gnas grib can du 'gro na bzlas shing phyin pas chog 'di la gtsang mi gtsang 'bags bsrung mi dgos/ de sngags rgod kyi nus pa yin gsungs// / paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bdag chen ma dkon mchog rgyal mo'i don du mdzad nas gnang ba yin no// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'jam dpal nag po'i nyams len zab mo bzhugs so// na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gser chos zab par grags pa/ 'jam dpal nag po'i gnad bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i gdams pa nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ thog mar/ dus kyi gnad tho rangs skar ma'i bkrag ma yal ba/ khang pa sgo'i gnad rang gi gnas khang sgo ma phye ba'i gong*/ lta ba phyogs kyi gnad kha shar du phyogs pas/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad lus skyil krung*/ sgal tshig drang por bsrang*/ bsgom pa lha'i gnad skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo dhīḥmathing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar rgyas pa'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' dang*/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams/ bzlas pa sngags kyi gnad ni/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥmathing nag gi mtha' mar sngags phreng kha dog nag po 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas g.yas skor du bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ dur mi sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ ṭaṃ rbad phaṭa swā hā zhes brgya rtsa'am/ ma grub na nyer gcig tsam bzla'o// 'bud pa rlung gi gnad ni/ nang gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad na bun gyi rnam par thon par bsams la/ rlung sna bug g.yas nas rngubs te g.yon nas 'bud pa lan gsum bya/ gdab pa rkan sgra'i gnad ni/ rkan sgra drag po lan gsum gtogs so// rten 'brel rdzas kyi gnad ni/ sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma srin lag gnyis la bskus pas/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi rgyu ma khug gi dreg pa cung zad brad/ byug pa bu ga'i gnad ni/ bu ga

bu ga dgu ni/ mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna gnyis/ kha/ 'og sgo gnyis so// dgu dang bcu drug 'di la ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba mang na'ang tshigs pa bcu drug par bzhed pa nyid don la gnas so// 'dzom du byug go /mnan pa mtheb rgya'i gnad/ rang la gnod byed kyi gtso byas/ srid pa gsum dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad zhabs 'og tu mnan par bsams la/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bos g.yon pa'i mthe bo lan gsum mnan/ 'di ni chag med du nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo// gzhan nam dgos pa'i dus su bzlas brjod byas pas chog go /de'ang shin tu rtsub cing rnam rtog ches za ba'i tshe/ gos mgo mjug ldog la gyon/ skra yod na spyi bor bcing*/ rang nyid 'jam dpal nag po khro bo 'jigs su rung ba/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar bas gdon bgegs la snun pa/ g.yon pusti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nyid nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong drag po zug pa/ nad ngan pa 'go ba'i rims/ gdon chen pos gnod dogs pa/ phyogs ngan bdud gcod/ lo zla zhag dang skar ma ngan pa/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs dpon dang*/ skye bo'i khrom dpon byed pa/ sa ma dul bar dbang bskur/ drag las sogs byed pa/ nam srod la 'gro 'dug byed pa/ ro grib sogs grib kyi rigs/ mi gtsang ba ltas ngan pa/ gnyan nad lhog pa sogs/ sa gnyan brkos pa/ shing gnyan gcod pa/ rdo gnyan rlog pa/ mkhar las gsar pa byed pa/ khang rnying bshig pa/ mdor na bza' ru mi btub pa bza' ba dang*/ nyo ru mi btub pa nyo ba sogs nyam nga ba rnam rtog ci byung yang 'di nyid nyams su blangs pas zhi bar 'gyur ba bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs shing nyams su myong bas kyang grub bo/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'o//

maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'jam dpal nag po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang 'dra/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa dhīḥyig mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung ba'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod/ 'dir ye shes dgug gzhug sogs gang yang mi dgos/ sngags ni/ oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ dur mi sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dzaḥ kaṃ shaṃ kaṃ rbad phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya stong nas nyer gcig yan ci 'grub bzlas la/ dge ba bsngo bar bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul la/ stegs ji ltar rigs par rten khebs sogs bkab pa'i steng maṇ+ḍal tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i mdun du dkar gtor rgyan ldan gcig bsham/ de'i mtha' skor ram mdun gang bder chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham/ de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/

de nas tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin las rang nyid ces pa dor/ spro na/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa māḥdzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas la/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par sems bskyed gsal btab/ 'dir skabs su bab pa gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam mnga' ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa zab chos lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba'i rim pa la/ slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs lan gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab/ slob ma rje btsun 'jam dpal nag por bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i dpral ba'i oṃ las rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i sku'i ngo bo oṃ yig dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig la thim zhing de dang mnyam du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs nag po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ 'bring po mi tshad tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa char chen po babs pa ltar byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes mang du brjod cing rol mo dang*/ rdor dril gsor dkrol bya/ des rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byas nas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i gsung gi ngo bo āḥyig dmar po dpag tu med pa byung*/

khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gsung gi ngo bo āḥyig gi phreng ba char babs pa ltar byon nas mgrin par thim pas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la sngar ltar rol mo bya/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung gi ched du slob dpon la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ces 'bul du gzhug slob dpon la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon dang 'jam dpal tha dad ma mchis pa'i thugs kar dhīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i dhīḥyig la thim par mos nas sngags 'di lan gsum rjes zlos mdzod/ ces rjes zlos byed du gzhug bcom ldan bdag gis sogs dang*/ bla mas/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ des rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ces sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis de gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig dpag tu med pa byung khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas kyang rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig dpag tu med pa byung khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sngar ltar sngags rol bya/ des rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ ces sogs gong gi rigs 'gres sbyar/ bar 'dir gnad bcu gcig dang bcas pa'i sgom lung 'bogs rjes/ gtso bos sogs/

maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa kha gsos la rjes chog spyi ltar bya'o// de ltar rje btsun 'jam dpal nag po'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa 'di ni rje bla ma sku drin 'khor thabs med pa de nyid kyi zhabs drung du gdams pa 'di lan grangs mang bar thob pa'i gsung rgyun phyag len ji lta ba bzhin rang gi dran pa gso phyir bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal lhun grub kyis bris pa'o// 'di'i rjes gnang sgom lung gi yi ge le tshan dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ bla ma mnyam med pa/ shākya pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ gu ge paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ drin chen rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ des bdag lhun grub la lan grangs du ma'i bar du rjes su bzung ngo*// yang na glo bo mkhan chen nas/ lha mchog seng ge sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse pa man 'dra/ yang na zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sa skya bu ston/ theg chen rin po che/ glang thang spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams lha dbang*/ lo pa ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ mchog legs rdo rje man 'dra'o// yang na brag phug pa nas/ blo bzang dkar mo/ dkon mchog thugs rje/ gling smad paṇ+ḍi ta shes rab dpal ldan/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ slob dpon chos mchog

bla chen yon tan rgya mtsho/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/ mtshungs med rnam rgyal bkra shis/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /gser chos 'jam dpal nag po'i brgyud 'debs byin rlabs mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyag rdor dze tā ri// rdo rje gdan pa che chung rin chen grags// gong ma rnam lnga dkon mchog mdo sde dpal// nam mkha' dpal ldan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma mnyam med shākya sa bzang pa// ngor chen grags rgyal legs 'byung sa lo che// dkon mchog lhun grub nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// mchog legs rdo rje rnams la= /bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// rmor chen rje dang 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sgom bzlas rnal 'byor mthus// mi mthun 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi ba dang*// phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
